content: As a second baseline, we use the two-pass CADec model BIBREF11. The first pass produces sentence-level translations. The second pass takes both the first-pass translation and representations of the context sentences as input and returns contextualized translations. CADec requires document-level parallel training data, while DocRepair only needs monolingual training data.
